g.text: State (DL-3) and Cfg_PortReset reach DL-4 to DL-7; CreditErr (DL-4) and Sent Null, Sent FCT (DL-5) reach DL-3; Rx errors reach DL-7.
Stat_*, Ev_*, Ecc_* and Inj_* connect the blocks with the MIB.
